name: Section
description: Semantic section wrapper with spacing and background tokens.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Breadth beta port: keyboard/ARIA contract reviewed, ForcedColors story added, Storybook axe gate (parameters.a11y.test: error).

forbiddenUse: Bypass design tokens or skip forced-colors verification at beta.
dense: Page band: spacing none|sm|md (default)|lg|xl + hero/follow pair (hero = roomy top tight bottom, follow = no top), background default|muted|accent|inverse; id/donnyTarget anchors

usage.description: Section is the page-level band: it owns vertical rhythm (`spacing`, responsive paddings) and surface (`background`), while Container inside it owns the horizontal clamp. `hero` and `follow` are a pair — the hero band keeps a generous top and tight bottom, and the section right after uses `follow` to avoid a double gap. `inverse` flips to the dark surface with matching text tokens. Give sections an `id` when they are anchor or skip targets.

bestPractices.description: Pair spacing="hero" on the page hero with spacing="follow" on the next section — that is what kills the double gap.
Alternate background="muted" sparingly to group related content; every-other-band zebra striping reads as noise.
Put a Container directly inside; Section handles vertical, Container horizontal.
Give anchor/deep-link targets an id (and donnyTarget only for whitelisted spotlight stops).
Do not nest Sections — bands are siblings; nesting compounds paddings and backgrounds.
Do not use Section inside components or cards; it is page architecture, not component padding.
